items.title: Ferrand Clementin Interview, 1973-08-02
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Who's the one for the plane? Sun John Money and the preacher.

ctx.x: No, he was an Arab friend. He was an Arab friend. Oh, he was an Arab friend. Arab friend for his kid, the bus around South Clay, the bus around the city was empty and big, what you call it. So they didn't wrap the schedule. So they're afraid you should come there and charge your dollars to go out to write, because writing was so funny. Every Sunday, there's plenty of people to sit up there writing. And so they said, Sun John Money comes there. The man made loose to the room for Sun John Money. And he went to do it.
Who's the one for the plane? Sun John Money and the preacher.

The preacher, so he wants to go to heaven. Everybody's going to go in there. You can see nothing. When he's gone there, he's going to go to heaven. When he's gone in there, when they make whoop-whoop, he went whoop-whoop. You know what? I'm sorry. I'm sorry. You see? Yeah. I wasn't even looked at the plane. But I didn't go too close. Yeah.
